etymology: ラテン語 solvere(ほどく・とく:solve と同じ根) → とくこと → 解決(策)・(とかした)溶液

en_definitions.text: a way to solve a problem; the answer to a puzzle; a liquid with something dissolved in it.

cautions: a solution to [for] A=Aの解決策(to が多い)
find a solution=解決策を見つける
